name: Space Journey
summary:
Welcome to Space Journey, an exciting game that takes you on an epic adventure through the galaxy! Explore new planets, encounter dangerous enemies, and upgrade your tools and weapons to become the ultimate space explorer.

In Space Journey, you'll have access to a wide range of upgradeable tools and weapons, allowing you to take on even the toughest challenges that the galaxy throws your way. Visit the shop to purchase new items and upgrade your existing ones, and keep track of your inventory to make sure you're always well-prepared for your next mission. You'll also have the opportunity to build your own spacecraft. And with planet physics that mimic the real-world physics of space, you'll need to use your wits and skill to navigate through the galaxy and avoid obstacles along the way.
